title: AARO Presentation for NASA Study Public Meeting 5.31.23
doc_notes: This document is an AARO presentation for a NASA study public meeting held on May 31, 2023, detailing UAP reporting trends, characteristics, and case studies.

incidents.summary: MQ-9 observed a spherical UAP in the Middle East.
incidents.quote: MQ-9 observed apparent spherical UAP via electro-optical sensors

incidents.summary: P-3 aircraft observed several equidistant UAP in the Western United States that it was unable to intercept.
incidents.explanation: Analyses of air-traffic control data suggest objects likely commercial aircraft transiting known flight paths.
incidents.quote: P-3 on training mission observed several equidistant UAP that it was unable to intercept
